ideas.pitch: A web-based dashboard that automatically parses user-submitted web application workflows, maps them to BPMN standards, and runs real-time risk assessments before code deployment.
ideas.title: WebFlow Governance Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a complex engineering problem in 12 hours by applying structured workflow validation to standard web development pipelines, fulfilling the core requirement of building a fully functional web app under strict time constraints.

ideas.pitch: A zero-training semantic routing interface built as a web dashboard that categorizes incoming web requests and API queries using an exemplar index to cut LLM routing costs.
ideas.title: Semantic Web Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by implementing kNN semantic routing over an exemplar index within a tight 12-hour build window, addressing high-performance web tooling demands.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous web application that detects anomalies in web application data pipelines, generates verified repairs, opens actual pull requests, and logs evidence gates in a visual dashboard.
ideas.title: Data Incident Web Console
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a concrete data engineering problem with end-to-end automation, appealing directly to judges looking for production-grade operational web tools rather than basic chat interfaces.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative web coding environment where two isolated AI agents review, test, and stress-test incoming code pull requests for subtle logic bugs and security flaws before human review.
ideas.title: Adversarial Code Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent adversarial interaction within a clean web interface, showing high technical ambition that stands out among standard CRUD apps at a web development hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A centralized web platform that acts as a federated MCP server dashboard, mapping and routing clinical data queries securely for medical-data web agents.
ideas.title: Clinical MCP Web Gateway
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines specialized domain utility with modern web infrastructure architecture, satisfying the demand for fully functional, highly complex web applications built under short deadlines.
